Bulletin No: 12 MWA/26/08/06/01
COLOR: Red
Warning for Strong Winds and Rough Seas
Issued by the Natural Hazards Early Warning Centre
Issued at 10.00 a.m. 06 August 2026
Valid for the period until 10.00 a.m. 07 August 2026.
For the sea areas extending from Matara to Pottuvil via
Hambantota
TAKE ACTION!
The sea areas off the coasts extending
from Matara to Pottuvil via
Hambantota will be very rough at
times with strong gusty winds up to
(60-70) kmph. Naval and fishing
communities are advised not to
venture into these sea areas, until
further notice.
The sea areas off the coasts extending
from Batticaloa to Matara via
Trincomalee, Kankasanthurai,
Puttalam, Colombo, and Galle will be
rough at times with strong gusty winds
up to (50-60) kmph. The naval and
fishing communities who are engaged
in fishing and naval activities in the
above sea areas are requested to be
vigilant in this regard.
Naval and fishing communities are
requested to be attentive to future
forecasts issued by the Department of
Meteorology in this regard.
